messages:
alex: PTAL — I addressed the review comments from yesterday. Reworked the batching logic to avoid the subtle OOM when KV cache rotates. Returned behavior to previous contract for small-request paths so Dedicated customers shouldn't see a change.

alex: Changes:
- added fallback to single-request path when batch size < 4
- preserved legacy kv-cache eviction order behind feature flag
- added unit + integration tests
I pushed a short compatibility note into the PR and a migration flag: FEATURE_KV_LEGACY=true
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123
Can we merge before EOD canary? There's a dependent canary scheduled.

maria: Taking a look now. Thanks for the summary.

jamal: Quick question — does the feature flag default to on or off in prod? Want to ensure canary behaves.

alex: Default is off in prod; default=true only in the test fixture. I added a note in the PR description and in the console rollout docs.

sam: LGTM in the diffs I checked. A few nits inline but nothing blocking. If @maria signs off, I'm happy to approve.

maria: Saw the tests. One flake in the kv allocator smoke test — I left a comment with a small wait fix (race on allocator refill). Please add sleep(0.1) in the test harness func.

alex: Added the test fix in a follow-up commit (force-push). Re-ran CI locally, all green. Commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/9b7c1a2

ci-bot: CI passed — unit + integration + smoke. No regressions detected. ✅

luis: @alex do we need a migration note for Dedicated customers? Might need a short heads-up email to the account owners.

alex: Good call. Drafted a short note and will post it to #eng-announcements and ping account mgmt after merge.

maria: PTAL again — lgtm except for one tiny doc nit (typo in the flag description). Fixed and approved.

sam: Approved. Will hold merge until the 30m canary window is scheduled.

alex: Thanks all. Merging in 5m and scheduling canary for 30m. :rocket:
